What's Changed
### Features
* Add Custom Notes feature for uninstaller entries by @ronimuliawan in https://github.com/BCUninstaller/Bulk-Crap-Uninstaller/pull/939

* Add dry-run mode to BCU-console uninstall command by @hazeliscoding in https://github.com/BCUninstaller/Bulk-Crap-Uninstaller/pull/968
* (Portable ver) Add Windows ARM64 support to launcher and publish script by @NihilDigit in https://github.com/BCUninstaller/Bulk-Crap-Uninstaller/pull/990

### Fixes
* Clarify uninstall progress - leftover scan next step by @One-Simon in https://github.com/BCUninstaller/Bulk-Crap-Uninstaller/pull/930
* Fix BCU-console hanging on Console.ReadKey() after showing help by @hazeliscoding in https://github.com/BCUninstaller/Bulk-Crap-Uninstaller/pull/966
* Uninstall: Execute the Confirmed Directory Entry by @zbalkan in https://github.com/BCUninstaller/Bulk-Crap-Uninstaller/pull/987
* Do not offer to send access denied error during junk backup creation by @Klocman in ebeaf7a86928024f88460c5da853eca121a67dcb
* Show a better error message for missing or blocked BCU files and do not offer to send by @Klocman in 693765fb211745ad0587f7383f75954019f05b08
* Catch OverflowException in HandleDestroy by @Klocman in 47078f9eb52bce1f3de3e2ea20b82f89391408ca
* Add additional error checking to NSIS quiet uninstall by @Klocman in e17302ccf5fe8c61126ede061beadd5ea9caf285

* Add Ukrainian language support by @serhiihoroshko in https://github.com/BCUninstaller/Bulk-Crap-Uninstaller/pull/965
* Update Ukrainian localization by @serhiihoroshko in https://github.com/BCUninstaller/Bulk-Crap-Uninstaller/pull/997

* Installer: verify current .NET runtime bootstrap by @zbalkan in https://github.com/BCUninstaller/Bulk-Crap-Uninstaller/pull/986
